findings.current: “Keep rowing! Put your backs into it and row!”
findings.defect: The standard expression “put your backs into it” removes the deliberately crude reference to their butts and weakens the comic command.
findings.rationale: 궁둥짝 explicitly means the buttocks and supplies the line’s coarse humor.
findings.replacement: “Keep rowing! Put your asses into it and row!”
findings.source: “계속 저어! 궁둥짝에 힘 빡 주고 저으란 말이다!”

findings.current: “It’s a shame. If your discernment and martial talent had been even half as good as your skill with ships, you might have taken your Senior Brother’s place.”
findings.defect: “Discernment” mistranslates 독심, which refers to Mu Song’s fierce tenacity or grit, not his judgment.
findings.rationale: The Seafaring King is evaluating Mu Song’s temperament and martial aptitude; 독심 denotes hard, tenacious resolve in this context.
findings.replacement: “It’s a shame. If your grit and martial talent had been even half as good as your skill with ships, you might have taken your Senior Brother’s place.”
findings.source: ‘아쉽구나. 네놈의 독심과 무재(武才)가 배 다루는 솜씨의 절반만 되었더라면 네 사형을 대신할 수 있었을 터인데.’

findings.current:
They had borrowed a small merchant vessel instead and set out for the place where Jin Taekyung’s group was said to have gone.

No, they had tried to set out.
findings.defect: The correction changes the action from trying and failing to advance toward the destination into trying and failing to set out at all, contradicting their ongoing voyage across the lake.
findings.rationale: 나아가려 했다 corrects 나아갔다: they successfully launched but could not continue advancing toward the destination.
findings.replacement:
They had borrowed a small merchant vessel instead and headed for the place where Jin Taekyung’s group was said to have gone.

Or rather, they had tried to.
findings.source:
자그마한 상선(商船) 한 척을 빌려 진태경 일행이 향했다는 곳으로 나아갔다.

아니, 나아가려 했다.

findings.current: It was impossibly tall, and as it approached the merchant vessel with its narrow column blocking the way
findings.defect: The draft makes the waterspout’s column narrow, while the source says the towering waterspout blocks the narrow waterway.
findings.rationale: 좁은 폭 is the confined passage the waterspout obstructs, not a description of the waterspout’s column.
findings.replacement: It towered to a dizzying height, blocking the narrow waterway as it advanced toward the merchant vessel
findings.source: 까마득한 높이의 그것이 좁은 폭을 틀어막은 채 상선을 향해 다가오자

findings.current: Even Bodhidharma of Shaolin used a reed leaf to cross a river.
findings.defect: The established monastic title 대사 is omitted.
findings.rationale: 대사 is an honorific for a senior Buddhist monk and is established here as “Master.”
findings.replacement: Even Master Bodhidharma of Shaolin used a reed leaf to cross a river.
findings.source: 소림의 달마대사도 강을 건너기 위해서 갈대잎을 사용했지.

findings.defect: “Deliberately” does not clearly preserve 짐짓, which indicates that Mungyeong is putting on or feigning the expression.
findings.rationale: 짐짓 marks the frown as affected rather than merely intentional, a small but explicit characterization cue.
findings.replacement: Mungyeong made a show of frowning.

findings.current: If I had prioritized martial arts, I would have brought Hyeongong of Wudang instead.
findings.defect: The draft omits Mungyeong’s pointed description of the venerable Hyeongong as a youngster, even though that display of extreme seniority directly causes the onlookers’ shock in the following paragraph.
findings.rationale: 그 아이 literally treats Hyeongong as a child; preserving that hierarchy is necessary to support the immediate reaction.
findings.replacement: If I had prioritized martial arts, I would have brought that youngster Hyeongong of Wudang instead.
findings.source: 무공을 우선시했다면 차라리 무당파의 현공(玄空), 그 아이를 데려왔겠지.

findings.current: A movement technique both stealthy and peerless.
findings.defect: “Peerless” means unrivaled and does not convey 표횰, which describes the technique as elusive and difficult to track.
findings.rationale: 표횰 characterizes the movement’s evasive, ungraspable quality rather than ranking it against other techniques.
findings.replacement: A movement technique both stealthy and impossibly elusive.
findings.source: 은밀하면서도 더할 나위 없이 표횰한 신법.

findings.defect: The entire System notice is bolded, contrary to the required panel format, which reserves bold for meaningful labels or internal emphasis.
findings.rationale: The source presents a single ordinary System line, not a bold label or emphasized field.

summary: One critical action error, two major characterization and hierarchy losses, and six localized humor, imagery, terminology, voice, and formatting defects.
